_comment: Per-model pricing table for cc-status-dot token cost estimation. USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Hot-editable — re-running the patcher is NOT required; the writer re-reads this file (mtime-cached) on every token-stats hook fire. Cache fields are optional; when absent the writer derives them from `in` using the canonical Anthropic prompt-caching ratios (cacheRead = 0.1x input, cacheCreate5m = 1.25x input, cacheCreate1h = 2x input). Set `_default: null` (or omit) to hide the $ suffix for any model not matching a glob below — this is what makes GLM/unknown models show token-only. matchRate (cc-status.js) picks the LONGEST-specificity glob on conflict (length of the non-`*` portion), so version-specific entries automatically win over family catchalls REGARDLESS of JSON ordering. Anthropic official pricing (verified 2026-07): Opus 4 / 4.1 = $15/$75; Opus 4.5+ (claude-opus-4-5-*, launched 2025-11-24) = $5/$25; Sonnet (all current 3.x/4.x) = $3/$15; Haiku = $1/$5.
